comment: Blamsoft publish no source. configParam gives Enable 0 to 1 default 1 with an EnableParamQuantity printing Off and On, Tone 0 to 1 default 0.5 shown as 0 to 11, Drive 0 to 1 default 0.5 shown as 0 to 11, Mix 0 to 1 default 1 shown as 0 to 100%, Level 0 to 1 default 0.75 shown as 0 to 11. The jack-to-knob map, the 0.1 per volt CV law and the clamp are identical to Grunge's. The maker's PDF manual was read with pypdf; it is the source of the account of the Tone filter and of the drive stage being mixed with the input rather than replacing it. The widget adds no context menu of its own.
